flow_note: The candidate evidence panel is the dominant dashboard flow; its no-candidate and unavailable states also use the empty-states checklist.

items.question: What is the primary task users return to complete?
items.why: A dashboard should make one recurring task obvious.
items.evidence: Review a candidate's source lineage, checker evidence, frozen policy and research-case result.

items.question: Which evidence is authoritative versus exploratory?
items.why: Trust depends on separating receipts from interpretation.
items.evidence: DSL, checker, policy, numerical fixture and registered research-case evidence are rendered as separate scopes.

items.question: What happens when there is no candidate or result yet?
items.why: Empty states should guide the next safe action.
items.evidence: The panel offers candidate creation; the research-case card stays unavailable until a supported lowering candidate exists.

items.question: How can users recover from an unavailable or failed run?
items.why: Recovery prevents duplicate work and accidental retries.
items.evidence: Errors preserve the candidate, use a deterministic idempotency key and expose a safe retry message.

items.question: Which actions are intentionally excluded from this surface?
items.why: Removing speculative controls keeps the dashboard focused.
items.evidence: The low-level numerical fixture is history-only; the single actionable research CTA is the frozen CPU protocol.

items.check: The primary dashboard action is visible without opening unrelated workflows.
items.evidence: The frozen CPU research case is the only actionable experiment control for a lowering candidate.

items.check: Loading, success, failure and unavailable states communicate what changed.
items.evidence: The UI uses live outputs, explicit outcome/replay labels and retry-safe notices.

items.check: Evidence scope and non-claims remain visible next to results.
items.evidence: Every research-case result states synthetic_operator_only_no_product_claim and shows holdout uncertainty.

items.check: Empty history does not look like a successful zero-result state.
items.evidence: No-result copy distinguishes no run from unavailable history and points to candidate creation.

items.check: The action is keyboard reachable and has a live progress announcement.
items.evidence: The CTA is a button, the protocol card is labelled and progress uses aria-live output.

items.check: Replay and stored-only states are distinguishable.
items.evidence: Report entries render replayed from frozen protocol versus stored receipt only.

items.check: The dashboard avoids duplicate calls during an in-flight request.
items.evidence: The researchCaseInFlight ref, disabled CTA and deterministic idempotency key are tested.

api_note: Flow checklists require a pro API key for live smell linkage and severity metadata. Internal checklist used.
